1.c4 e5 2.e3 d6 3.Nc3.strategy: Develops the knight to the centre, where with the c-pawn it controls d5 and e4. White's quiet set-up stays flexible: the next moves decide between a slow fianchetto and an active plan in the centre.

1.c4 e5 2.e3 d6 3.Nc3 Nc6.strategy: Develops a piece and adds protection to e5 while keeping the centre intact. The knight also watches d4 and b4, discouraging an early central break by White.
